text_block_list.text: —The day before the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, preparations are complete! Ah, I 
can't wait to get started...!

Agnes Tachyon got ready and left the 
dormitory to head for Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, well, if it isn't Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you are also heading to 
Kyoto Racecourse now? If I recall, you are 
scheduled to run in the Kikuka Sho, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Were you perhaps waiting for me? To go 
together? Of course—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, it's not. It was just a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Come now! I know you don't actually 
dislike me that much!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say before that you were using 
me as a reference for your own 
self-improvement?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What was it again? That was a long time 
ago. Weren't they talking about something 
regarding 'running form'?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I was just a little concerned. Her 
running form... felt different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's all coming back to me now! Man, I 
just couldn't spoil the surprise back 
then, you know!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...The big reveal...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your eye for observation was spot on! 
Indeed, at that moment, my 'mindset toward 
running' had changed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for trying to dodge the question. 
It's just that I have my own unavoidable 
circumstances—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, if I recall... I remember telling 
her "I'm betting on your future" back then 
too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, right. Sorry, but I called that 
off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Even without betting on you, it looks 
like I can make it on my own legs."

Hearing that, Manhattan Cafe's expression 
softened slightly.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, was that supposed to be funny?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No. I did think it was unlike you, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph? Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"—Well, I should be heading off soon. What 
about you—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll be out in 5 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh, is that so? Understood.

Manhattan Cafe quietly watched Agnes 
Tachyon's back as she began to walk away.

The next day. Kyoto Racecourse was buzzing 
with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon, huh? She was written down 
as a "problem child," wasn't she? I just 
hope she doesn't do anything weird today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I saw the article; she's got quite an 
attitude. She seems talented, but... we'll 
see.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...'Expectations from the audience remain 
low'—it says. Well, I suppose that's only 
natural..."

The negative campaign against Agnes 
Tachyon that spread after the incident at 
the "Laurel Cup" seemed to be extremely 
effective—

In the stands, few voices held any high 
expectations for her. However, the girl 
herselfâ

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Things were rather noisy out there. It 
seems I've become quite the topic of 
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, none of that matters right now. 
What we need to focus on is, yes—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How Plan A connects to the Kikuka Sho! 
This directly links to our future! It is a 
truly epoch-making, monumental matter!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, to put it plainly... Today is when 
we give it everything we've got!
